title: Grateful Dead Live at Curtis Hixon Convention Hall on 1973-12-18
lineage: SBD Reel master > cassette > DAT > CDR (unknown gens) > EAC > CDWav retracking> SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a jazzy ’73 show, highlighted by a soaring Dark Star and stellar Eyes of the World.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clear, crisp sound (with only minor audio hiccups) and captures a tight, adventurous performance. Reviewers repeatedly call out the smoking Dark Star, the magical China → Rider segue, and an inspired Eyes of the World, while noting strong vocals from Jerry and Bobby. Overall the show is regarded as one of the standout 1973 concerts.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer star ratings (average ~4.4) and overwhelmingly positive comments about both performance and recording quality drive a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and clear with A+ SBD comments; a few reviewers note minor audio mess‑ups but overall the mix is balanced and very listenable.

standout_songs: Weather Report Suite Parts I & II
poor_songs: Weather Report Suite Parts I & II (not great according to one reviewer)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is solid but not the absolute best; the second set shines with jazzy interplay, tight transitions, and a volcanic energy that carries through the extended jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals praised on Wharf Rat and Great Story; guitar work in Dark Star described as “dripping with teases” and he “ate his Wheaties”.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for tight playing, especially after Bertha; overall band cohesion highlighted.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby's vocals on Jack Straw noted (though some feel outshone), contributes strong rhythm guitar throughout.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy’s drum solo praised as a highlight; the percussion drives the momentum into Eyes of the World.
